subject: Request to reconvene demo — new security & procurement attendees
content:
From: Tom Baker <tom.baker@novamed.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>, partners@avasolutions.com
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning schedule

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the session yesterday — the team found the overview useful. One change on our side: Procurement and our security engineering lead are now requesting to join the next call. Also, our Infra lead (traveling) is only reliably free after July 4. Given those constraints, can we move the demo so they can participate?

We'd like to:
- Have a technical run-through for platform & infra (60 min)
- Follow up with procurement & security for contract/QoS/Qs (30 min)

Two asks: is Redwood able to split the session into a 60/30 format? And can you provide the security checklist and SOC2 evidence link in advance so our security folks can triage?

Appreciate it — Tom
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaMed Systems

---

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@novamed.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, partners@avasolutions.com, Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning schedule

Tom — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the momentum getting more stakeholders involved. Splitting into a 60/30 format makes a lot of sense and is something we can support. Proposed plan:

Option A (recommended):
- Mon, Jul 8 — 10:00–11:00 PT: technical demo (product + infra deep dive) — SE + solutions engineer (Priyom) leading
- Mon, Jul 8 — 11:15–11:45 PT: procurement & security Q&A — Soojin + Vivek leading

Option B (if Jul 8 conflicts):
- Wed, Jul 10 — 09:00–10:00 PT / 10:15–10:45 PT (same split)

I've attached an updated agenda and the security checklist that Vivek maintains. We can also surface SOC2 Type II evidence through our compliance portal (link below) once we have NDA/LOA cleared — happy to send the DocuSign if you want an expedited path.

Attachments: [redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf], [redwood-security-checklist.pdf]
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cDemoPrep

Would either Option A or B work for you? If your infra lead needs post-holiday availability, we can push to the following week.

— Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

---

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@novamed.com>, Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning schedule

Thanks — quick notes from the SE perspective:
- For the infra deep-dive we should reserve time to show: autoscaling policy examples, KV cache behavior for long-context customers, and a live latency dashboard. That will take ~30–40 minutes if we demo real traffic patterns.
- Suggest we keep the procurement/security time strictly Q&A to avoid runover — 30 min max.
- I'll prepare a short appendix of logs/observability screenshots to drop into the agenda (will send by EOD Monday).

Also flag: if NovaMed's security team requires SOC2 evidence before the procurement call, we should surface the compliance portal link now (I can redline the NDA if needed).

— Priyom (SE)
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Tom Baker <tom.baker@novamed.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>, partners@avasolutions.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning schedule

Sooj,

Option A (Mon, Jul 8) looks good for most of the team, but our infra lead still has travel that week and asked if we can move the technical demo to Tue, Jul 9 10:00–11:00 PT instead, with procurement/security staying on Tue 11:15–11:45 PT. Hope that's not too disruptive on your side.

If you can confirm and send calendar invites, we'll lock in attendees. We also need the security checklist and the SOC2 portal link in advance for our security lead to triage items before the Q&A.

Thanks — Tom

---

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Tom Baker <tom.baker@novamed.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Sarah Li <sarah.li@novamed.com>, partners@avasolutions.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — aligning schedule

Tom — confirmed. We'll update to Tue, Jul 9 with the split session and send invites shortly.

Deliverables before the call:
- Security packet: redwood-security-checklist.pdf (attached) and SOC2 evidence portal: https://compliance.redwood.ai/clients/novamed (temporary access granted for NovaMed, will expire in 30 days)
- SE appendix: observability screenshots + comment doc (Priyom will upload by 7/5)
- Agenda: final attached (redwood-demo-agenda-v2.pdf)

Calendar invites will include two events:
1) Redwood — Technical deep-dive (Jul 9, 10:00–11:00 PT) — join: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/987654321
2) Redwood — Procurement & Security Q&A (Jul 9, 11:15–11:45 PT) — join: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/987654322

If anything else changes on your side, ping me and we'll adapt. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
— Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
